items: How much does a locksmith cost in Seattle?

It depends on the job. At {{business}}, house and car lockouts start at $65, lock rekeying at $35 per lock, car key replacement at $85 and key duplication at $25. You get a firm price before any work starts, with no hidden fees. All starting prices are on our services page.
What should I do if I'm locked out of my house?

Don't force a window or break the lock. Call us 24/7 at {{phone}}: a technician usually reaches homes in Seattle and the Eastside within the hour and opens most locks without damage. We ask for ID showing you live there before opening the door.
Is there a 24-hour emergency locksmith near me?
Yes. {{business}} answers day and night, weekends and holidays, across Seattle, Woodinville, Bothell, Kirkland, Redmond, Bellevue and the other cities on our service-area page.
How long does it take a locksmith to arrive?

Most calls inside Seattle are reached in 20 to 40 minutes, and calls in the Eastside and north-end cities within the hour, depending on traffic. The dispatcher gives you an arrival time when you call.
Can a locksmith make a car key without the original?
Yes. We cut and program a new key on site for almost every make and model, even when every key is lost, so there is no tow and no dealer wait. You'll need ID and proof that the car is yours.
Is it cheaper to get a car key from a locksmith or the dealer?
A locksmith is usually cheaper and faster: we come to you, there is no tow, and there is no waiting for parts. Car key replacement starts at $85 and a spare car key at $45.
Can a locksmith program a key fob or push-to-start key?
Yes. We program remote-head keys, smart keys and push-to-start fobs at your location, usually in minutes, starting at $85.
Can a locksmith copy a chip car key (Hyundai, Kia, Toyota, Honda)?

Yes. We clone or program transponder (chip) keys for most makes, including Hyundai, Kia, Toyota, Honda and Ford. A spare car key starts at $45, a fraction of the cost of replacing a key after the last one is lost.
Should I rekey or replace my locks?

Rekey when the locks work fine and you only need the old keys to stop working; it is cheaper, starting at $35 per lock. Replace them when they are damaged or worn, or when you want an upgrade such as a smart lock or a high-security lock.
Should I rekey my locks after moving into a new home?
Yes. Previous owners, tenants, cleaners or contractors may still have keys. Rekeying makes every old key useless, and we can set all your doors to one new key in a single visit.
Will a locksmith damage my door or car when unlocking it?
No. We use non-destructive tools made for each lock and vehicle. Drilling is a last resort, and we tell you before we do it.
What do I need to show a locksmith?
For a home or business lockout, a photo ID with the property's address. For a car, a photo ID plus the registration, title or insurance in your name.
My key broke off in the lock. What should I do?
Don't push it deeper or try glue. We extract broken keys without damaging the lock, starting at $35, and can cut a new key on the spot.
Can a locksmith open a safe if I forgot the combination?
Yes. We open home and office safes and gun safes, starting at $75, then reset the combination or fit a new lock so you can keep using the safe.
How do I choose a trustworthy locksmith?
Pick a local business with real Google reviews that gives you a firm price on the phone and again before any work starts. {{business}} is rated 5.0 on Google and every estimate is free.
